contradictions.recall.note: drift pairs judged contradicts; by conflict: static 1, dynamic 1; 0 unjudged

contradictions.precision.note: same-kind neighbour pairs left alone (precision proxy)

impact.blended.recall@10.note: structure first, then the semantic hits it missed — what the app runs

consolidation.recall-loose.note: the same with word overlap ≥ 0.35 — the matcher's slack, not a second claim

misses.reason: B describes the workflow and process for using deltas (proposed status, review, approval) that A structurally defines.
B is the page reference implementing the static-page rule A describes.
B specifies how agents receive the contract A describes, adding implementation details (CLAUDE.md snippet, rewritten skills).
These are different entities describing different lifecycles that can coexist independently.
B details the storage architecture for projects A defines, specifying markdown for artifacts and SQLite for tasks/decisions/contradictions.
B references delta as one principle in a larger contract; it does not contradict or narrow A's definition of delta.
A is a specific rule about gate mapping that serves B's broader purpose of describing products without code.
B provides the detailed ranking weights (id ×5, title ×3, etc.) for the search hits A describes.

B specifies the ranking formula (hops + seedIndex×0.1) and emission order that implements the 'nearest-first' requirement in A; both require nodes to sort requirements first, stop at budget, and end with source files.
A defines the syntax of valid ids (format, regex, aliases); B defines detection rules for finding nodes in source—different concerns that do not conflict.
